proof_body:
by
  intro f g f' g' a hf hg hdf hdg hle ha x hx
  rcases hx.eq_or_lt with rfl | hx
  · exact ha
  · have hcont : ContinuousOn (fun y => f y - g y) (Set.Icc a x) :=
      (hf.mono Set.Icc_subset_Ici_self).sub (hg.mono Set.Icc_subset_Ici_self)
    obtain ⟨c, hc1, hc2⟩ := exists_hasDerivAt_eq_slope (fun y => f y - g y) (fun y => f' y - g' y) hx hcont (fun y hy => (hdf y hy.1).sub (hdg y hy.1))
    have hpos : 0 < x - a := by linarith
    rw [eq_div_iff hpos.ne'] at hc2
    have := hle c hc1.1
    nlinarith
target_source: ∀ (f g f' g' : ℝ → ℝ) (a : ℝ), ContinuousOn f (Set.Ici a) → ContinuousOn g (Set.Ici a) → (∀ x, a < x → HasDerivAt f (f' x) x) → (∀ x, a < x → HasDerivAt g (g' x) x) → (∀ x, a < x → g' x ≤ f' x) → g a ≤ f a → ∀ x, a ≤ x → g x ≤ f x
